answer: Because the echo nonce is published only after close, the grove audit can verify each derivation and a shared text is provable as copied. That removes the entire premise of a template farm, which depends on one text serving many identities, and forces a separate beacon derivation per key. The three words are derived from a 151 bit value mixing the epoch seed with the identity key, so no two keys ever receive the same triple. That is 3 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
